prompt: Which statement best summarises how the causes of a current account imbalance affect its significance?

options.label: A
options.text: Absolute monetary size alone determines an imbalance’s significance.

options.label: B
options.text: Investment imports may matter less than persistent competitive weaknesses.

options.label: C
options.text: Every surplus is beneficial, including those caused by severe recessions and falling domestic household consumption.

options.label: D
options.text: Deficits are equally harmful regardless of their underlying causes.
